cues.en: In his famous research paper, Gears from the Greeks, historian Derek DeSola Price put forward a stunning theory regarding the device known as the Anti-Kythra Mechanism. That the origins of our modern day engineering achievements
cues.zh: 历史学家 Derek DeSola Price 在其著名研究论文《Gears from the Greeks》中，就被称为 Anti-Kythra Mechanism 的装置提出了一个惊人理论：我们现代工程成就的起源，

cues.en: What he called our recent age of high technology could be found in this ancient device. He theorised that the profession of clock and instrument making had acted as a silent carrier of a larger and much older technology tradition. That embedded in the daily output of clockmakers were the fundamental elements of modern engineering, such as gearing, linkages, shafts and bearings. Some of the key elements that had led to the scientific and industrial revolutions, and then everything that had followed.
cues.zh: 他所说的我们近代的高科技时代，可以在这一古老装置中找到。他推断，钟表与仪器制造这一行业一直是更宏大、更古老技术传统的沉默载体。钟表匠日常产出中嵌入的，正是现代工程的基本要素，如齿轮传动、连杆、轴和轴承。这些也是促成科学革命与工业革命、以及随后一切发展的部分关键要素。

cues.en: Clockmakers, he said, had played a crucial role in the emergence of our modern world, and that the clockmaking tradition itself was part of a distinguished main line of technology that could be directly traced all the way back to the Antikythera Mechanism. The ancient Greeks had written the original language of the mechanical engineer, and had left behind a record of it in this incredible device.
cues.zh: 他说，钟表匠在我们的现代世界兴起过程中发挥了关键作用，而钟表制造传统本身就是一条卓越技术主线的一部分，这条主线可以直接追溯到 Antikythera Mechanism。古希腊人写下了机械工程师的原始语言，并在这台不可思议的装置中留下了它的记录。

cues.en: a calculating machine that used complex mathematics and precise engineering to model the ancient Greek understanding of the cosmos. A single input wheel drove a complex combination of gears, pins, slots and pointers, so that the operator could directly compute and most importantly predict the position of the naked eye celestial objects, the date and time of eclipses, and even some of the characteristics of those eclipses. The phase of the moon, retrograde motion of the planets,
cues.zh: 这是一台计算机器，用复杂的数学和精密的工程来建模古希腊人对宇宙的理解。单个输入轮驱动由齿轮、销钉、槽和指针组成的复杂组合，使操作者能够直接计算，最重要的是预测肉眼可见天体的位置、日月食的日期与时间，甚至这些食的某些特征。月相、行星的逆行运动，

cues.en: and even barely observable details, like the procession of the lunar orbit, were all modelled according to ancient Greek astronomical theory. For our modern understanding of the history of science and technology, it's likely to be the single most important object ever uncovered from ancient times. Now I should point out that this is not the first time that someone has made a version of the Antikythera Mechanism, in fact far from it. There have been more than a dozen reproductions that I'm aware of.
cues.zh: 甚至像月球轨道进动这样几乎难以观测的细节，也都按照古希腊天文理论建模。对于我们现代人理解科学技术史而言，它很可能是古代出土的最重要的单一物件。现在我要指出，这并非第一次有人制作 Antikythera Mechanism 的版本，事实上远非如此。据我所知，已有十几件复制品。

cues.en: the most notable of which are the two constructed by Michael Wright. But as far as I'm aware, no one has fully documented the construction process on video, showing all of the engineering details and challenges as they would have been experienced by the original maker. Now you're going to want to see me complete the project within a reasonable time frame, so I'll mostly use the usual power tools that you've seen in previous videos. But there will also be plenty of opportunity to investigate some of the construction
cues.zh: 其中最著名的是 Michael Wright 制作的两件。但据我所知，还没有人用视频完整记录整个制作过程，展示原制作者会经历的所有工程细节和挑战。现在你们会希望看到我在合理时间内完成这个项目，所以我主要会使用之前视频里见过的常用电动工具。但也会有很多机会去探究一些制作

cues.en: as it would have been undertaken by the original maker more than 2,000 years ago. The data for the reproduction will be sourced from the latest research, mostly from the published work of Tony Free and his colleagues of the Anti-Kithra Mechanism Research Project. I've used his published gear schematics and dimensions, together with the raw scan data to generate what I think is a faithful CAD model of the mechanism. You can find links to that research in the description box below.
cues.zh: 也就是原制作者在两千多年前可能会采用的做法。复制所需的数据将来自最新研究，主要来自 Tony Free 及其同事在 Anti-Kithra Mechanism Research Project 中发表的工作。我使用了他已发表的齿轮示意图和尺寸，连同原始扫描数据，生成了我认为忠实于该机构的 CAD 模型。你可以在下方描述栏中找到该研究的链接。

cues.en: Of course, after so much time underwater, a lot of those dimensions are quite uncertain, and you'll be able to see for yourself that a lot of the engineering detail in the scans is obscured, corroded or simply missing. So a lot of the fun of building this reproduction is going to be had in figuring out exactly how the original maker solved each problem. Now for materials, the device was mainly constructed from a low tin bronze.
cues.zh: 当然，在水下待了这么久之后，其中很多尺寸都相当不确定，你自己也能看到，扫描图里大量工程细节被遮挡、腐蚀，或者干脆缺失。所以，制作这个复制品的一大乐趣，就在于弄清原制作者究竟是如何解决每个问题的。材料方面，这个装置主要用低锡青铜制造。

cues.en: The closest modern equivalent is a particularly expensive material in my part of the world, and it's probably not an authentic match anyway. So while I will cast the raw stock for some of the parts from a homemade bronze for convenience, I'll make the majority of the device from commercially available brass stock. Either choice should deliver similar mechanical properties to the original, and I think will be consistent with the spirit of the overall device. Now there were of course no threaded fasteners used in the original.
cues.zh: 现代最接近的替代材料，在我这边贵得离谱，而且可能也做不到真正的匹配。所以，虽然为了方便，我会用自制青铜给某些零件铸造坯料，但装置的大部分我会用市售黄铜坯料制作。无论选哪种，机械性能都应该和原件相似，我认为这也符合整个装置的精神。当然，原件没有使用螺纹紧固件。

cues.en: It mainly has rivets, pins, latches and solder to hold everything in place, with the wood casing providing the overall supporting structure. These elements will be reflected in the reproduction, but the wooden case presents a small problem with regard to this video series. It would obstruct a lot of the mechanism, and prevent you from seeing everything as it's being built, and we can't have that. So I'll construct the mechanism using these temporary support pillars that you've been watching me make for the last few minutes. It'll keep the whole thing open.
cues.zh: 它主要用铆钉、销钉、锁扣和焊料固定所有部件，木壳提供整体支撑结构。这些元素都会体现在复制品中，但木箱给这个视频系列带来一个小问题。它会挡住很多机构，让你无法在建造过程中看到全部，这我们可受不了。所以我会用这些临时支撑柱来搭建机构，过去几分钟你一直看我做这些柱子。这样整个结构都能保持敞开，

cues.en: and easily viewed during the majority of the build. At the end of the project, I can either remove the pillars entirely and replace them with the original wooden structure, or I could perhaps do some sort of combination of both pillars and detachable casing, so that the internal wheelwork can be viewed as the device is operated. I'll leave that decision until much later in the build. Of course, there's plenty more to figure out, and so much more to discuss, as I go through the process of building this beautiful machine.
cues.zh: 并且在大部分制作过程中都很容易观看。项目结束时，我可以把支柱完全拆掉，换成原来的木结构；或者也许把支柱和可拆卸外壳做成某种组合，这样装置运转时也能看到内部齿轮机构。这个决定我会留到制作后期再做。当然，在制作这台精美机器的过程中，还有更多东西要弄清楚，也有更多可聊的。

cues.en: Stick around, I'm sure it's going to be a lot of fun. Thanks for watching, I'll see you later. Now if you'd like to help me make these videos, and you're not sure if you can go through an entire year without seeing something a bit closer to modern horology, then I've got just the thing for you. Commencing from February 2017, a modern reproduction of the second oldest geared mechanism from Antiquity, the device known as the Byzantine Sundial Calendar, also known as the London Sundial Calendar. I'm giving it the full reproduction treatment.
cues.zh: 别走开，我肯定这会很好玩。感谢观看，回头见。现在，如果你想帮我制作这些视频，又不确定自己能不能整整一年都不看到更接近现代钟表工艺的东西，那我正好有适合你的东西。从2017年2月开始，我会完整复制古代第二古老的齿轮机构——也就是被称为 Byzantine Sundial Calendar 的装置，又称 London Sundial Calendar。我会对它进行完整复制。

cues.en: but more from the perspective of how an 18th century clockmaker might have tackled the project. So you'll see all of the techniques and materials that I've started to explore with the Skeleton Clock project, but developed further to work on this much more condensed scale. Patrons get the same deal as for the first Patron Series project, exclusive access to the build videos, free plans for the Patron Series projects, and of course the added bonus that one lucky patron will get to keep the finished project at the end of the build.
cues.zh: 而是更多地从18世纪钟表匠会如何着手这个项目的角度出发。因此，大家会看到我在骨架钟（Skeleton Clock）项目中探索过的所有工艺与材料，为了适应这种更紧凑的微缩尺寸而做了进一步深化。赞助者享受与首期 Patron 系列项目相同的福利：独家观看制作视频、免费获取 Patron 系列项目图纸，当然还有额外的惊喜福利——制作完成后，会有一位幸运赞助者能把这件成品带回家。
